paragraphs: A guideline-grounded Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) prototype for Emergency Departments, Rural Diagnostic Centers, and Mass Casualty Incidents. 👉 Live Application: housemdai.netlify.app
Overview • Key Features • How It Works • Guidelines • Quick Start • Configuration • API • Limitations • License

In emergency triage, an AI model that invents a diagnosis is worse than one that says "I'm not sure". AegisMed is built around that idea: the diagnosis and triage level shown to the clinician come from a curated guideline database, not from free-form model output.
features: Search: The presentation is matched against 36 emergency guidelines stored in ChromaDB, using a vector search plus a keyword check.

Grounded AI: If a guideline matches, only the matched guideline text is given to the LLM, which writes the summary, justification and action steps. The condition name and triage level in the response are taken from the…
Database fallback: If every AI model fails, the API still answers with the matched guideline's condition name, triage level and treatment steps.

No matching guideline: The AI is still asked for a general assessment, but the answer is clearly labelled NOT grounded in verified guidelines. If no AI model is available either, the API answers "Not Sure" /…
🎯 Guideline-grounded answers: Headline diagnosis and triage level come from the curated database; the LLM only explains and elaborates.
